headline: VOLTEX
speaker_note: Title cover. Establish immediate impossible-to-ignore product identity with one dominant name, one short tagline, and a single hero visual that makes the object feel real, toy-like, and shockingly physical. Speaker notes should frame the opening as: do not start with explanation; start with the object and let the room feel the category rupture first.

headline: LOOK AT WHAT THE CAMERA HAD TO ADMIT
speaker_note: First argumentative slide. Lead with the tactical gap: in a category built on fake spectacle, documented-looking backyard imagery is the advantage. Speaker notes should present Voltex as the rare toy whose most persuasive asset is not rendering but disbelief-provoking photography. Use only mockup/illustrative imagery, not implied real proof.

headline: WHY IT READS AS A TOY INSTANTLY
speaker_note: Translate form factor into parent and retail legibility. Emphasize that the silhouette, materials, and two-hand interaction are engineering-driven and aggressively non-firearm. Speaker notes should stress that the same constraints that make the physics work also force a safer, more legible play object.

headline: HOW THE SHOT WORKS
speaker_note: Explain the mechanism simply enough to remove disbelief without drowning the room in physics. Speaker notes should present the sequence as an engineering fact: charge, ignite, confine, release, dissipate. This is Newton-style credibility through calm mechanism, not hype.

headline: WHY KIDS PUSH IT AND PARENTS ALLOW IT
speaker_note: Show demand logic and the social theater of backyard play, while pairing it with the safety case grounded in mechanism limits. Speaker notes should argue that thrilling and bounded are not opposites here; the same physical limits that constrain the projectile create the purchase rationale.

headline: GO-TO-MARKET: STARTER UNIT + CHROMATIC REFILLS
speaker_note: Close with commercialization logic, proposed pricing, and the ask implied by the deck. Speaker notes should convert amazement into shelf strategy: a premium starter that earns attention, plus recurring color-cartridge revenue and collectible variants. No invented traction; this is a proposal slide.
